verdict.rationale: Shopify itself exposes a merchant's catalog to AI agents through the Storefront Catalog MCP endpoint on every UCP-enabled shop and through the cross-merchant Global Catalog. Runtime probes confirm both endpoints are live. However, the evidence documents only the agent-side read APIs; it shows no merchant-facing feed or import API for publishing or controlling what agents see, and marketing frames discovery as automatic ('You don't lift a finger'). missing for 10: a documented merchant-side feed/import or publishing API, merchant controls over catalog inclusion in agent surfaces, publishing to non-Shopify agent channels, independent merchant corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can publish my product or service catalog into agent surfaces through a documented feed or import API so AI agents can discover what I sell

citations.quote: the same UCP catalog tools served per-merchant at the shop's own /api/ucp/mcp endpoint
